scenarios.name: unoccupied_damper_open
scenarios.description: Reference vector: fan on, damper 30%, unoccupied; alarms after alarm_delay (900 s)

scenarios.name: unoccupied_damper_closed
scenarios.description: Reference vector: fan on unoccupied with the OA damper commanded shut — the intended night sequence

scenarios.name: occupied_damper_open
scenarios.description: Reference vector: fan on, damper 30%, occupied — minimum OA is required

scenarios.name: fan_off_damper_open
scenarios.description: Damper left open unoccupied but the fan is off; no air is being drawn, so no ventilation waste

scenarios.name: damper_at_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: damper exactly at oa_closed_threshold (5%); the comparison is strict, so leakage-band positions do not alarm

scenarios.name: damper_just_above_threshold
scenarios.description: Threshold edge: damper 0.1% above oa_closed_threshold alarms on the same schedule as a wide-open damper

scenarios.name: damper_closes_within_alarm_delay
scenarios.description: Transient: the unoccupied sequence drives the damper shut at t=600 s, before alarm_delay completes; never alarms

scenarios.name: damper_reopens_restarts_persistence
scenarios.description: Transient: damper closes at t=600 s then reopens at t=1200 s; persistence restarts from the reopen, alarming at 2100 s

scenarios.name: occupancy_resumes_resets_persistence
scenarios.description: Transient: the occupied period starts at t=600 s while the damper is open; the timer resets and never alarms
